Geometry-derived analysis shows Bi and V centers each coordinated by five O neighbors, while Mg adopts 5- and 6-vertex oxygen coordination environments. Oxygen centers are surrounded by 3–5 metal neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and edge-sharing between 6-vertex Mg polyhedra and corner- and edge-sharing between 6-vertex Mg and 5-vertex Bi polyhedra.
